title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Anaerobic Digester Samples
author: Abhijeet Singh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgxkjxkw

steps.title: Prepare sample in lysing matrix
steps.instruction: Weigh 250 mg solid/semi‑solid sample (or add 200 µL liquid sample) into a Lysing matrix E tube and label the tube on the side (not on the cap).

steps.title: Make lysis master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex Sodium phosphate buffer (SPB) and MT buffer (MTB) from the kit; calculate volumes as SPB = 978 µL × (X+Y) and MTB = 122 µL × (X+Y) where X = number of samples and Y = extra/reserve samples; add the calculated volumes to a tube and mix gently by vortexing.

steps.title: Add lysis mix to sample
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the prepared lysis master mix to each Lysing matrix tube containing the sample and recap tightly.

steps.title: Bead‑beat cells
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a FastPrep‑24 homogenizer and bead‑beat for 40 seconds at speed 6.0.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 14,000 g for 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare binding matrix tube
steps.instruction: Vigorously vortex the binding matrix to resuspend particles; pipette 1 mL of binding matrix into a labelled 5 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Combine supernatant with binding matrix
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from the lysate into the 5 mL tube containing 1 mL binding matrix, invert the tube for at least 2 minutes (do not vortex), then incubate 5–10 minutes at room temperature (or 4 °C) until the mixture becomes clear.

steps.title: Prepare PPS buffer tubes
steps.instruction: Label 2 mL centrifuge tubes and add 250 µL PPS buffer to each.

steps.title: Add PPS and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from the lysing tube to the PPS‑containing tubes, mix by pipetting or gently invert ~20 times (≈20 seconds), then centrifuge 5–10 minutes at 14,000 g.

steps.title: Load spin filters
steps.instruction: Label quick‑clean spin filters; discard 500–700 µL of clear liquid without disturbing the settled binding matrix; gently mix the remaining liquid with the matrix and transfer 600 µL to each labelled spin filter; centrifuge 1 minute at 14,000 g and discard filtrate; repeat with the remaining suspension.

steps.title: Prepare 5.5 M guanidine thiocyanate
steps.instruction: Dissolve 64.988 g guanidine thiocyanate in 100 mL sterile deionized water, stir with a magnetic stirrer and heat until fully dissolved; solution can be stored for several weeks.

steps.title: Add guanidine to spin filter
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of the 5.5 M guanidine thiocyanate solution directly to each spin filter, resuspend the binding matrix, then centrifuge at 14,000 g for 1 minute (or until liquid is removed) taking care not to damage the filter.

steps.title: Prepare SEWS‑M buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 mL of 100 % ethanol (≥95 %) to a new SEWS‑M buffer bottle; the buffer can be stored for several weeks.

steps.title: Wash with SEWS‑M
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of ethanol‑added SEWS‑M buffer to each spin filter, flick to mix, centrifuge 14,000 g for 1 minute until liquid is removed, discard filtrate, replace spin filter into its tube, centrifuge the empty filter 2 minutes to dry the matrix, then air‑dry the matrix 3–5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute DNA with DES‑water
steps.instruction: Place spin filter into a labelled 1.5 mL catch tube, add 70 µL DES‑water directly to the binding matrix, flick to mix, incubate 1–2 minutes at room temperature, then centrifuge at 14,000 g for 2 minutes to collect eluate.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and store
steps.instruction: Evaluate DNA quality by agarose‑gel electrophoresis; measure concentration with a Qubit fluorometer (or nanopore); label and seal the DNA tubes and store at –20 °C.
